title: Sebastian and the Tryouts
author: Ada Nystrom
blurb: Ada Dravenmoor, the team's statistician who knows the game is rigged, counts days until graduation like a sentence being served. Then the teacher pairs nemesis with nemesis for a semester-long project — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must win the championship that doesn't matter — and the one that does, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
